label: Royer 2020 CoFe2O4/silica composite: reported local constant approximation

provenance.title: Enhancement of Both Faraday and Kerr Effects with an All-Dielectric Grating Based on a Magneto-Optical Nanocomposite Material
provenance.original_article_license: ACS AuthorChoice, non-commercial copying/redistribution terms; see publication. Only numerical facts and original provenance notes are reproduced here.
provenance.material: CoFe2O4 nanoparticles in TEOS-derived silica sol-gel
provenance.measurement_note: Refractive index measured by ellipsometry in an area without Si3N4 grating. Off-diagonal value is reported as corresponding to the nanoparticle volume fraction; not a complete separately measured tensor spectrum for every coated slit.
provenance.magnetic_state: Room-temperature saturated magneto-optical spectra; applied-field sweep in the experiment 0 to 0.8 T. A calibrated M(H) curve is not included.
provenance.conversion: epsilon_d=(n+i*kappa)^2; interpreting reported epsilon_MO as epsilon_xy, repo g=-i*epsilon_MO.
provenance.spectral_policy: Two identical endpoints encode an explicit local constant approximation over 1550-1570 nm. They are not two separate measured data points and are not a measured dispersion curve. No extrapolation.
provenance.sign_policy: m_z=+1 denotes the adopted source tensor sign. Absolute applied-field and viewing conventions need experimental calibration. Magnetic reversal changes the sign of g.
provenance.scope: Effective composite model reported for the experimental sample. Not pure CoFe2O4, not a generic photoresin, not demonstrated two-photon-printable ink.
